harnessAssessment.transactionPath: LabExecution.perform calls ActionProcessor.process, records actual action/result before driver stopping, and installs returned native state. CostPaymentBoundary catches LabStopped only after observation, reads native Outcome directly and sends actual SubmitDecision actions. It does not implement payment or replace a native result.
harnessAssessment.rawConsistency: All 16 after states equal the corresponding nativeResult.state. Every observed rejected boundary action preserves exact serialized input state and has zero events. Choice pending state is serialized in continuationStack Suspension.question, not a top-level pendingDecision property.
harnessAssessment.seeding: Native positions are explicitly constructed research fixtures, not organically played histories. Owner/controller edits occur before actions only; borrowed fixture changes both owner fields. No claim about arbitrary continuous-effect control or legal game-reachability.
limits: Current new boundary harness tests only three source ability scopes and two Caterpillar refusal cases; it is not ten-scope runtime qualification.
Normal nonmana effects are left on stack. Scope checks cannot establish scry/draw/search/damage/destruction behavior.
Freshness definition equality is checked only over receipt-provided definition keys; hardcoded bounded scenario inventory is not an exhaustive catalog sample.
Boundary diagnostic/check labels are derived convenience summaries and were not used as source authority.

Original harness hardcodes rejected success as ILLEGAL_ACTION and treats native Paused as driver unsupported. This mislabels downstream refusal/incomplete workflow without corrupting retained raw native results.
Original sufficient-mana checks inspect final pool totals; these seeded no-producing-side-effect cases are informative but not a general mana payment/event accounting proof.

provenanceFinding.issue: CostExamination.report compares raw frozen source/native hashes stored in execution-requirements and nested phase records with evidenceTextDigest LF-normalized hashes. Raw source 151853... differs from normalized ff1ce6...; raw native 07a44c... differs from normalized 6eb291.... Thus sourceCurrent/nativeCurrent predicates as inspected reject these same-content frozen inputs as stale. The native observations remain hash-bound; this is a report freshness convention mismatch, not evidence that source mechanics changed.
provenanceFinding.adjudicationConsequence: Top-level frozen raw hashes are intentionally not rewritten to make current reader pass. Report freshness and adjudication-current status remain limited until hash conventions are reconciled in separately authorized work. No approval is inferred from a matching hash.

originalMethodAssessment.requirements: Original ten expected payment trees agree with frozen independent source derivation; whole-source ability coverage includes both Mind Stone abilities. Declaration/resolution dependencies remain separate.
originalMethodAssessment.comparison: Useful reusable bounded structural comparator: flattens mandatory ALL conjunctions, preserves nonmana multiplicity and source/granter/selected distinction, adds exact fixed mana quantities, distinguishes generic from required colorless and rejects unknown/dynamic/alternative structures as unresolved.
originalMethodAssessment.semanticBoundary: SACRIFICE_SELECTED canonical text bakes controller/owner/destination labels into comparison. Those labels require native-semantic evidence and bounded execution such as Phase B/new borrowed case; equality alone does not prove them.
originalMethodAssessment.mutations: Original twelve mutations contain ten structurally detected contradictions, one unsupported Forage alternative and one intentionally unchanged-cost target/effect defect outside payment scope. Only missing-mana and missing-sacrifice mutants were executed in retained receipt; raw observations demonstrate respectively free-of-mana activation and failure to sacrifice. Reexamining them does not constitute fresh mutation execution.
originalMethodAssessment.additionalChallenge: CostExamination.additionalChallenge makes Viscera Seer excludeSelf=true. Frozen source and SDK defaults require source allowed; comparator includes excludeSelf, so this is a valid additional structural distinction. No execution of that mutant was performed or independently observed in Phase C.
limits: Hand-selected source cohort and finite designed mutants do not establish whole-catalog recall or mutation completeness.
Held-out claims are technical sequencing within same implementing coordinator, not human blind qualification.
No printed cost mutation exercises the new strategy-dependent runtime bug because serialized costs remain correct.
Target/effect defect remains outside payment comparator scope. No whole-ability, whole-card or strategic recommendation follows.
Potential tap-tree counts are native inventory only; do not count them as confirmed affected/source-reviewed physical cards.

reuseAssessment: Reuse frozen source expectations, exact native bindings, bounded structural projection, raw native receipt format and public transaction/decision driver for research. Preserve observed runtime contradictions and diagnostic/freshness limits. Do not reuse structural SUPPORTED or broad counts as payment-execution certification or automatically promote assurance.
